action.description: The command action to perform: list, parse, or del.

email_pattern.description: Wildcard pattern to match recipient email addresses.

msg_pattern.description: Wildcard pattern to match server error messages.

size_lower.description: Lower bound for message size in bytes.

size_upper.description: Upper bound for message size in bytes (0 for no upper limit).

select_active.description: If true, select only active queue entries.

select_hold.description: If true, select only on-hold queue entries.
